g.text: IX. The state — public power of capital, not a source of value
I. The relation the state belongs to
monopoly of the means of life
public power of the capitalist class
source is the product of labour
mostly a cut of s; can stick in v
still M - C … P … C' - M'
if it buys LP and sells
Interest, rent, and tax are claims
on the product of labour. The state
Who writes the cheque is not
the source: wages can be the conduit.
If the value of labour-power holds,
a wage-tax tends to be shifted onto s.
If it sticks, real wages fall:
a cut into necessary labour, still
not a new creation of value.
can stick as a cut in
mistakes a share for a source
mistakes a change of title for
Tax is a share of the product; nationalisation is still capital: notes/state.md
